next.reason: 1985 GR18: on invalid key the WRITE 'is unsuccessful, the content of the record area is unaffected and the I-O status ... is set to a value indicating the cause'; execution proceeds per the invalid key rules. 2023 §2023:14.9.51.4 GR15: an unsuccessful WRITE does not take place, 'the content of the record area is unaffected', and the status is set 'to a value indicating the cause of the condition', control per 9.1.14; §2023:9.1.14 GR1 sets the invalid key status, and §2023:9.1.14 GR2 and §2023:9.1.14 GR3 give the transfer of control with and without INVALID KEY, as 1985 IX-6 did. Same.
